register_decomposition_for_jvp: register a JVP decomposition function for a given aten operator using the register_decomposition_for_jvp decorator
maybe_register_decomposition: register a decomposition for an aten operator with safe exception handling via the maybe_register_decomposition decorator
_register_jit_decomposition_for_jvp: register a JIT graph decomposition for forward-mode autodiff by calling _register_jit_decomposition_for_jvp with an operator and optional python mode
recompute_mean_var: recompute mean and variance from input, rstd, and dimension indices for normalization backward decompositions
native_layer_norm_backward: decompose native_layer_norm_backward for forward-mode autodiff by computing gradients with recomputed mean and rstd
native_batch_norm_backward: decompose native_batch_norm_backward for forward-mode autodiff by computing gradients using saved mean, invstd, and output mask
trace_decomposition: decompose aten.trace.default as torch.sum(torch.diag(self)) for forward-mode autodiff support
log_sigmoid_forward_decomposition: decompose aten.log_sigmoid_forward.default into min and z components for forward-mode autodiff support
decomposition_table_for_jvp: access the decomposition_table_for_jvp dictionary that maps aten operators to their forward-mode autodiff decomposition functions
